notes.title: Added support for Traditional Chinese
notes.content:
We supported for Traditional Chinese.

You can change the language setting from the below steps:
1. Start Steam Client
2. Go to [LIBRARY]
3. Right-click [Kamimachi-Site] and select [Properties]
4. Click [LANGUAGE] tab and choose language
